pages.text: Nothing in the homestead tier is locked. Andesite alloy, water wheels, mechanical presses, mixers, saws, belts, funnels, chutes, wagons and docks are yours from day one.$(br2)What you cannot make yet is $(bold)brass$() — and everything brass unlocks. The dead took it. See Blueprints & Recovery.
Create's own book (the ponder screens — hold $(bold)W$() over an item) explains every machine. This almanac only tells you which doors are closed and which bosses hold the keys.
